meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: Accidental Exposure
quests.narrative_guidance: Expose Overseer Hadrin’s cover-ups of deadly accidents.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the hidden accident logs from the Smelter Spire.
Broadcast the data using the Magnetic Pulsar's high-gain antenna.
Ensure the transmission is logged permanently at Sorting Floor Gamma.

quests.title: The Scavenger's Claim
quests.narrative_guidance: Assist Kessa Thrane in claiming a wreck from the Drone Foundry.
improvisation_points: Identify the target wreck in the Scuttle-Yard.
Reposition the docking clamps at the Grapple Docks.
Escort the salvage team through Hull-Drift Alley.

quests.title: Foundry Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the Drone Foundry and sabotage its AI core.
improvisation_points: Bypass the sound sensors in the Silence-Sector.
Disable the security drones at the Grinding Maw.
Inject the virus into the central server in the Forgotten Vaults.

quests.title: The Compactor's Secrets
quests.narrative_guidance: Unravel the cult’s rituals and discover their true origins.
improvisation_points: Decode the rhythmic chants in Piston Row.
Gain access to the inner sanctum beyond the Iron Jaw Gates.
Retrieve the relic from the bottom of the Quench Pools.

quests.title: The Whistleblower's Route
quests.narrative_guidance: Smuggle evidence with Joren Veyl to an outside faction.
improvisation_points: Recover the encrypted drives from Joren Veyl in the Spire.
Hide the drives inside an oxygen tank at the O2 Scavenge-Post.
Deliver the package to Tahl Vex for transport out of the station.

quests.title: Illicit Trade Lines
quests.narrative_guidance: Help Tahl Vex secure an illicit trade route through the station.
improvisation_points: Establish a meeting point in the Void-Walk Bazaar.
Sabotage the radiation sensors in the Solar-Shield Ward.
Cut a path through the obstacles in the Wire-Thicket.

quests.title: Chasing the Echo
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate the Whispering Echo and decide whether to silence or harness it.
improvisation_points: Listen for the signal origins in the Cog-Wheel Slums.
Boost the audio clarity using sensors in the Oil-Slick Caverns.
Confront the source of the transmission at the Data-Scrap Sprawl.

quests.title: The Sump Leak
quests.narrative_guidance: Expose Overseer Hadrin's safety cover-ups by gathering evidence from his own subordinates.
improvisation_points: Gather internal memos from Joren Veyl in the Piston Shaft.
Encryption-break the files using Hex-Code Hari at the Data-Leech Terminal.
Submit the proof to Lease-Lord Leo to force a public broadcast.

quests.title: The Great Wreck Hunt
quests.narrative_guidance: Help claim a legendary wreck from the dangerous outskirts of the Sump.
improvisation_points: Get the coordinates from Zip Quick-Step in Scrap-Haven.
Locate the specific hull-plate signature with Bone-Picker Bo.
Coordinate the crane recovery with Crane-Hook Elara.

quests.title: Digital Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the AI network to weaken the security perimeter of the Spark-Pit.
improvisation_points: Steal an override chip with Silent-Step Silas.
Upload the virus via Drone-Master 44X.
Fix the fried circuits afterward with High-Volt Vinnie.

quests.title: Sacred Compression
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover the ancient blueprints of the Compactor's first ritual tools.
improvisation_points: Recover the lead casing from Ash-Eye Bart.
Navigate the molten paths with Heat-Walker Hek.
Reforge the artifact using Anvil-Gut Grish's furnace.

quests.title: The Black Market Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Smuggle a shipment of illegal tech components across Scrap-Haven.
improvisation_points: Receive the package from Jax Wire-Puller at the Plaza.
Coat the package in anti-sensor resin from Mossy Mari.
Drop the package off at Lead-Pipe Larry's solder shop.

quests.title: Ventilation Monopoly
quests.narrative_guidance: Secure the trade route through the Forge-Ring by bribing or bypassing the guards.
improvisation_points: Negotiate the price with Cog-Swap Cora.
Avoid the security patrol with help from Talon-Hand Tess.
Clear the physical obstructions in the vents with Breezy Brutus.

quests.title: Echoes of the Past
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate the strange signal coming from the Echo-Hull and decide its fate.
improvisation_points: Track the signal source with Mist-Stalker Mira.
Record the sequence from The Whispering Echo.
Decipher the lock on the vault that holds the source with Vault-Breaker Val.

quests.title: The Whistleblower's Log
quests.narrative_guidance: Expose the Syndicate's safety cover-ups using internal data logs.
improvisation_points: Obtain the log from Foreman Burn in the Slag Rivers.
Secure a historical comparison from Curator Cache in the Memory Well.
Deliver the evidence to Proxy Agent P to force a Syndicate investigation.

quests.title: The Scrap Queen's Prize
quests.narrative_guidance: Help Salvage-Bot Scrap claim a valuable wreck stuck in the Piston Pits.
improvisation_points: Negotiate salvage rights with Salvage-Bot Scrap.
Reverse the piston direction with Gearhead Gax to free the wreck.
Reinforce the wreck's hull with Welder Weld for transport.

quests.title: Frequency Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the Archive to disable a rogue security signal core.
improvisation_points: Collect a jamming device from Frequency-Fixed Freq.
Overload the Ignition Chambers via Spark-Priest Flare to create a distraction.
Place the jammer in the Tension Tunnels to collapse the signal grid.

quests.title: Ashen Rituals
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate the origins of the furnace cult and their strange mechanical worship.
improvisation_points: Recover ritual ash samples from Gas-Guard Filter.
Decipher the cult's prophetic echoes with Vision-Caster Glitch.
Plant a 'holy' mechanical flower in the Rivet Gardens for the cult.

quests.title: The Data Smuggle
quests.narrative_guidance: Smuggle classified mineral reports past the Archive scanners.
improvisation_points: Get the hidden data chips from Analyst Sift.
Scrub the digital signatures with Code-Cleaner Null.
Exfiltrate the data through the Void-Lock with Air-Tight Seal.

quests.title: Black Market Gyros
quests.narrative_guidance: Secure a secret trade route by calibrating the station's rotation.
improvisation_points: Request the trade manifest from Casting-Chief Cinder.
Synchronize the Gyroscope Plaza rotation with Spinner Spun.
Validate the logic gates with Boolean B to ensure the sensors are blind.

quests.title: Echoes of the Void
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate the strange signal emanating from the station's depths.
improvisation_points: Locate the signal source with Optimizer Sort in the Defrag District.
Cool the signal receptors with Breeze-Mech Zephyr's fans.
Harness the signal's energy at Gravity Anchor 01 with Mass-Master G.
